title: Dispatcher over email, SMS, and push channels
task: Implement a `notify` package with a `Dispatcher` that delivers a `Notification{To, Subject, Body string}` over email, SMS, or push. Email renders `Subject: <subject>` then a blank line then the body; SMS renders the body cut to 160 characters; push renders `<subject> | <body>`. Each channel writes to its own `io.Writer` for now. Adding a fourth channel later must not mean editing the dispatcher.
